title: Owner request
description: The one request envelope every trusted owner (runtime control S6, broker S7) accepts, and the one response grammar it answers with (engine.md — Effect ownership and late requests). Owners are serialized per Workstream by mutation epochs; an owner rejects any request whose epoch is older than the last epoch it accepted for that Workstream.

epoch.description: Mutation epoch for the Workstream; owners reject epoch < their recorded value.

attempt_key.description: Stable attempt identity. A reused key with a different payload digest is rejected_key_mismatch; the same key and digest returns the recorded result.

operation.description: Registered owner operation (e.g. create_pod, cleanup_pod, attach_grant, detach_grant). Positive operations are forbidden on retired targets.

target.description: The concrete target identity (Pod UID, Agent id) or a reserved slot the owner created before dispatch.

payload.description: Operation payload. Never carries credentials or bearer tokens.

payload_digest.description: SHA-256 of the canonical JSON payload.

revision_set.description: The immutable revision set the request was resolved under; stale revisions are rejected.
